title: Cloudflared Tunnel LoopRuntime wrapper values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on CF Tunnel deployment drift. Catches: empty tokenSecret refs (silent tunnel-doesn't-register), replicaCount=0 (no HA), image.tag=latest (drift), metricsPort outside non-privileged range (would conflict with runAsNonRoot).

replicaCount.description: Cloudflared replicas. Default 2 for HA (CF Tunnel handles connection multiplexing). 0 is a legitimate DISABLED state used by cell.helmfile for multi-cluster LOCAL topology (standalone-multi: 4 separate k3d clusters use direct cross-cluster networking, no CF Tunnel). >10 = diminishing returns + CF tunnel session overhead.

repository.description: Container image repository. Default cloudflare/cloudflared (Docker Hub official).

tag.description: Image tag. 'latest' explicitly REJECTED (Bug #16 pattern: drill DOCR rejects, prod has supply chain risk). Use date-stamped or SemVer release.

name.description: Secret resource name (RFC 1123 DNS label). MUST match Secret created by generate-runtime-secrets.sh. Mismatch = tunnel pod CrashLoopBackOff with 'CLOUDFLARED_TOKEN env not found'.

key.description: Secret data key holding the actual tunnel token value (default 'token').

metricsPort.description: Cloudflared metrics + liveness/readiness port. <1024 = privileged port (would require root; conflicts with non-root pod). Default 2000.
